title: Wilted Ukrainian Fermented Pierogi
description: A recipe for wilted Ukrainian fermented pierogi using chives and ferment-jang, perfect for a low-glycemic-friendly meal.
instructions: Combine chive and ferment-jang filling ingredients in a bowl.
Mix mashed potatoes and pierogi dough together until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or glass.
Place a spoonful of chive and ferment-jang filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the pierogi to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the pierogi hot with a sprinkle of chopped scallions and fresh chives.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
